name: print-social-lavender-event-rundown-poster-with-time-slot-rows
title: Lavender 'Event Rundown' poster with outlined time-slot rows and a circled back arrow
whatItIs: A portrait pale lavender poster with a 'TehHub' logo, a thin 'EVENT' over heavy 'RUNDOWN' between rules with a circled arrow, date and venue boxes, and eight outlined rows pairing a lavender time cell (09:00 AM) with a session name, plus a contact footer in a rounded band.
whatItMeans: Tidy and calm; the thin outlines feel like a friendly form.
techniques: Pair a light and heavy weight for a two-word title.
Use outlined rows with a filled time cell.
Put date and venue in twin info boxes.

vocabulary.definition: A running order of an event.
A small filled box holding a time.
